Services de soutien et d&rsquo;entretien d&rsquo;installations
Nord du Canada
(comprend des exigences en mati&egrave;re de s&eacute;curit&eacute;)
Objectif du pr&eacute;sent pr&eacute;avis d&rsquo;approvisionnement
Il ne s&rsquo;agit pas d&rsquo;une demande de soumissions ni d&rsquo;une demande de propositions.
La pr&eacute;sente est un pr&eacute;avis d&rsquo;approvisionnement (PA) pour des contrats potentiels comportant des exigences de s&eacute;curit&eacute; anticip&eacute;es afin de fournir aux entrepreneurs int&eacute;ress&eacute;s, l&rsquo;occasion d&rsquo;entamer le processus de parrainage en vue d&rsquo;obtenir l&rsquo;attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute; pr&eacute;vue. Veuillez noter qu&rsquo;il n&rsquo;y a aucune garantie que ces sollicitations auront lieu ou que des attestations de s&eacute;curit&eacute; seront accord&eacute;es dans le cadre du processus de parrainage en temps opportun.
Description du projet et des services
Le minist&egrave;re de la D&eacute;fense nationale&nbsp;(MDN) a besoin des services de soutien et d&rsquo;entretien d&rsquo;installations pour une centaine de b&acirc;timents existants et l&rsquo;infrastructure des services publics connexes, repr&eacute;sentant au total une surface hors &oelig;uvre brute d&rsquo;environ 60&nbsp;000&nbsp;m2. En plus des b&acirc;timents, les sites vis&eacute;s par des dispositions du projet comprennent des services publics, des stationnements, des trottoirs, des routes et des espaces paysagers.

Les sites sont situ&eacute;s aux endroits suivants&nbsp;:
Manitoba&nbsp;: Churchill
Territoire du Nord-Ouest&nbsp;: Inuvik et Yellowknife
Yukon&nbsp;: Whitehorse
Nunavut&nbsp;: Eureka, Resolute&nbsp;Bay, Gascoyne&nbsp;Inlet, installation navale de Nanisivik, Rankin&nbsp;Inlet et Iqaluit

Les services fournis par l&rsquo;entrepreneur peuvent varier selon le site&nbsp;: tous les services &eacute;num&eacute;r&eacute;s seront planifi&eacute;s ou fournis sur demande.

	Services primaires



	Entretien de l&rsquo;enveloppe de b&acirc;timents
	Syst&egrave;mes de chauffage, de ventilation et de climatisation&nbsp;(CVC) et syst&egrave;mes de r&eacute;frig&eacute;ration
	Syst&egrave;mes de portes
	Syst&egrave;mes &eacute;lectriques
	Ascenseurs et syst&egrave;mes de levage
	Syst&egrave;mes de plomberie
	Syst&egrave;mes d&rsquo;alarme et d&rsquo;extinction d&rsquo;incendie
	G&eacute;n&eacute;ratrices



	Syst&egrave;mes de s&eacute;curit&eacute; des personnes
	Syst&egrave;mes de s&eacute;curit&eacute; et de contr&ocirc;le de l&rsquo;acc&egrave;s
	Appareils &eacute;lectrom&eacute;nagers et &eacute;quipement de cuisine



	Services auxiliaires



	Services de lutte int&eacute;gr&eacute;e contre les parasites
	Services d&rsquo;am&eacute;nagement et d&rsquo;entretien paysagers
	Services de nettoyage et d&rsquo;entretien
	Services de gestion des d&eacute;chets dangereux
	Services environnementaux
	Services de d&eacute;neigement et de d&eacute;gla&ccedil;age
	Services de gestion des d&eacute;chets solides
	Services de soutien &agrave; la facturation de services publics



	Services de soutien



	Gestion et coordination des services
	Gestion du programme d&rsquo;entretien
	Pr&eacute;paration et intervention en cas de situations d&rsquo;urgence
	Conseils en mati&egrave;re d&rsquo;investissement
	Services de d&eacute;pannage

L&rsquo;entrepreneur devra aussi entreprendre des travaux en dehors de la port&eacute;e des services planifi&eacute;s et fournis sur demande. Le prix, la gestion et la mise en &oelig;uvre de ces travaux seront &eacute;tablis selon un processus de demandes de travaux suppl&eacute;mentaires (DTS).
Les services seront fournis par l&rsquo;interm&eacute;diaire de march&eacute;s des services d&rsquo;entretien et de soutien des installations. Un seul march&eacute; servira &agrave; couvrir les emplacements du Manitoba, des Territoires du Nord-Ouest et du Yukon (valeur totale potentielle estim&eacute;e&nbsp;: 280&nbsp;M$) et un march&eacute; distinct servira &agrave; couvrir les emplacements du Nunavut (valeur totale potentielle estim&eacute;e&nbsp;: 200&nbsp;M$). Chaque contrat initial est appel&eacute; &agrave; &ecirc;tre d&rsquo;une dur&eacute;e de cinq (5) ans, avec la possibilit&eacute; de deux (2) p&eacute;riodes optionnelles suppl&eacute;mentaires de trois (3) ans chacune, pour une dur&eacute;e totale potentielle pouvant atteindre onze (11) ans.
Cette sollicitation sera lanc&eacute;e durant la p&eacute;riode de l&rsquo;hiver&nbsp;2026-2027 et les services commenceront &agrave; l&rsquo;hiver&nbsp;2028. Ceci est conditionnel &agrave; l&rsquo;approbation des projets par le minist&egrave;re de la D&eacute;fense nationale (MDN).

Le gouvernement du Canada est d&eacute;termin&eacute; &agrave; favoriser la r&eacute;conciliation et un engagement significatif avec les peuples autochtones. Conform&eacute;ment &agrave; ces engagements, le MDN souhaite cr&eacute;er des occasions pour les entreprises et communaut&eacute;s autochtones en offrant des contrats de sous-traitance, des emplois et d&rsquo;initiatives de formation li&eacute;es au programme des travaux propos&eacute;s.

Les communaut&eacute;s autochtones devraient b&eacute;n&eacute;ficier de contrats de sous-traitance, d&rsquo;emplois et d&rsquo;initiatives de formation d&eacute;coulant de ce programme de travaux.
Exigences &eacute;ventuelles en mati&egrave;re de s&eacute;curit&eacute; et d&rsquo;attribution du contrat
Pour &ecirc;tre admissible &agrave; l&rsquo;attribution d&rsquo;un contrat, un proposant devra, entre autres, d&eacute;tenir toute cote de s&eacute;curit&eacute; requise avant la date de l&rsquo;octroi du contrat, comme il sera indiqu&eacute; en d&eacute;tail dans les documents de la sollicitation.
Le niveau d&rsquo;attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute; pr&eacute;vu pour ce contrat est une attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute; d&rsquo;installation (ASI).
le programme de parrainage de s&eacute;curit&eacute; industrielle (PSI) 
Construction de D&eacute;fense Canada (CDC) offre aux firmes d&rsquo;experts-conseils ou aux entrepreneurs l&rsquo;opportunit&eacute; de se faire parrainer en vue d&rsquo;obtenir une attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute; par l&rsquo;entremise du Programme de s&eacute;curit&eacute; industrielle (PSI). Par cons&eacute;quent, les firmes d&rsquo;experts-conseils ou les entrepreneurs qui pr&eacute;voient pr&eacute;senter une proposition ou une soumission pour un ou plusieurs de ces projets et qui ne d&eacute;tiennent pas activement les attestations de s&eacute;curit&eacute; identifi&eacute;e ci-dessus doivent commencer imm&eacute;diatement le processus de demande d&rsquo;attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute; en faisant la demande par l&rsquo;interm&eacute;diaire du PSI de CDC.
Dans le cadre de ce programme, CDC peut, &agrave; son enti&egrave;re discr&eacute;tion, fournir une aide pr&eacute;liminaire pour le processus de parrainage visant l&rsquo;obtention d&rsquo;une attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute;.
Pour commencer ce processus, veuillez pr&eacute;senter une demande de parrainage &agrave; CDC en suivant les &eacute;tapes suivantes qui se trouvent sur son site Web &agrave;&nbsp;: https://www.cdc-dcc.gc.ca/industrie/exigences-de-s&eacute;curit&eacute;.
Dans la demande de parrainage qu&rsquo;ils pr&eacute;sentent &agrave; CDC, les firmes d&rsquo;experts-conseils ou entrepreneurs sont pri&eacute;s de notamment indiquer les renseignements suivants&nbsp;:

	Le num&eacute;ro du Pr&eacute;avis d&rsquo;approvisionnement; (num&eacute;ro de projet dans l&rsquo;avis de MERX)
	Le num&eacute;ro du contrat&nbsp;84735; et,
	Le niveau de cote de s&eacute;curit&eacute; demand&eacute; dans le cadre du parrainage.


Processus de parrainage
&Agrave; la r&eacute;ception d&rsquo;une demande de parrainage, CDC l&rsquo;examine et communique directement avec la firme d&rsquo;experts-conseils ou entrepreneur pour compl&eacute;ter le dossier.
Une fois que CDC a d&eacute;termin&eacute;, &agrave; son enti&egrave;re discr&eacute;tion, qu&rsquo;une firme d&rsquo;experts-conseils ou un entrepreneur&nbsp;:

	a d&eacute;but&eacute; le processus de parrainage avant que la ou les sollicitations (num&eacute;ro(s) de contrat indiqu&eacute; sur leur demande de parrainage) ne soient annonc&eacute;es sur MERX,
	a satisfait &agrave; toutes les exigences mat&eacute;rielles de la trousse de demande de parrainage, et
	a d&eacute;pos&eacute; une proposition ou une soumission

CDC enverra la trousse de demande de parrainage au Programme de s&eacute;curit&eacute; des contrats (PSC) de Services publics et Approvisionnement Canada (SPAC).
Apr&egrave;s la r&eacute;ception du dossier de demande de parrainage, le PSC communique directement avec le proposant ou le soumissionnaire pour lui indiquer les prochaines &eacute;tapes, les mesures &agrave; prendre ou l&rsquo;&eacute;tat du traitement du dossier. Le proposant ou le soumissionnaire devra alors coop&eacute;rer avec le PSC en temps opportun pour faire avancer le processus.

5 Wing Goose Bay Program
5 Wing Goose Bay, newfoundland and Labrador
(with AND WITHOUT Security Requirements)
Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice

This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals.

In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform contractors/consultants of upcoming contract opportunities at 5 Wing Goose Bay for Real Property Operations Group (RP OPS) and Canadian Forces Housing Agency (CFHA) base programs.
The purpose of this APN is to allow contractors and consultants to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for potential solicitation processes, notably by initiating any necessary steps.

This is a preliminary notice regarding potential contracts, which may or may not include security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested contractors and consultants to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable).

Please note that certain projects may be reserved for Indigenous businesses in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB).
Please note that there is no guarantee that these solicitations will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process.

DESCRIPTION OF 5 WING GOOSE BAY

5 Wing Goose Bay is situated in Happy Valley-Goose Bay, a town in the province of Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada. This Royal Canadian Air Force base is in central Labrador, at the southwestern limit of Hamilton Inlet, approximately 200 kilometers (km) inland from the Labrador coast. The base covers an area of approximately 52 km2 with the main operational area built approximately 30 metres (m) above sea level on top of a sandy plateau.

Operations at the base include a wide variety of functions such as military training, supporting NORAD operations and 444 Search and Rescue Squadron. The base is also home to a quick reaction alert complex which is used as a Dispersed Operating Base (DOB). The base features multiple aircraft hangars, an ammunition compound, barracks and administrative buildings.

Goose Bay Airport is an international airport that operates within the confines of the military base. It features two runways (Runway 08-26 and Runway 15-33), an 8,000 foot (ft) emergency landing strip, and Air Traffic Control that operates 24/7 with full VFR and IFR capabilities.

The employs roughly 200 regular force members, reserve members and civilian employees. Services at the Base are provided by a third party on behalf of DND.

DESCRIPTION DE LA 5E&nbsp;ESCADRE GOOSE BAY

La 5e&nbsp;Escadre Goose Bay est situ&eacute;e &agrave; Happy Valley-Goose Bay, une ville de la province de Terre-Neuve-et-Labrador, au Canada. Cette base de l&rsquo;Aviation royale canadienne est sise au centre du Labrador, &agrave; l&rsquo;extr&eacute;mit&eacute; sud-ouest de bras Hamilton, &agrave; environ 200&nbsp;km &agrave; l&rsquo;int&eacute;rieur des terres depuis la c&ocirc;te du Labrador. La base s&rsquo;&eacute;tend sur une superficie d&rsquo;environ 52&nbsp;km2 et sa zone op&eacute;rationnelle se dresse &agrave; environ 30&nbsp;m au-dessus du niveau de la mer sur un plateau sablonneux.
Les op&eacute;rations sur la base englobent une grande vari&eacute;t&eacute; de fonctions comme l&rsquo;instruction militaire et un soutien aux op&eacute;rations du Commandement de la d&eacute;fense a&eacute;rospatiale de l&rsquo;Am&eacute;rique du Nord (NORAD) et au 444e&nbsp;Escadron de recherche et sauvetage. On y retrouve &eacute;galement un complexe d&rsquo;alerte de r&eacute;action rapide qui sert de base op&eacute;rationnelle de dispersion (DOB). La base compte plusieurs hangars d&rsquo;a&eacute;rodromes, un d&eacute;p&ocirc;t de munitions, des casernes et des b&acirc;timents administratifs.
L&rsquo;a&eacute;roport de Goose Bay est un a&eacute;roport international qui exerce ses activit&eacute;s &agrave; l&rsquo;int&eacute;rieur de la base militaire. Il comporte deux pistes (piste 08-26 et piste 15-33), une bande d&rsquo;atterrissage d&rsquo;urgence de 2&nbsp;438&nbsp;m (8&nbsp;000&nbsp;pi) et un contr&ocirc;le de la circulation a&eacute;rienne en fonction 24&nbsp;heures sur 24, 7&nbsp;jours sur 7 qui offre des capacit&eacute;s compl&egrave;tes de r&egrave;gles de vol &agrave; vue (VFR) et de r&egrave;gle de vol aux instruments (IFR).

La base emploie environ 200&nbsp;membres de la Force r&eacute;guli&egrave;re, de la Force de r&eacute;serve et du personnel civil. Les services sur la base sont assur&eacute;s par un tiers pour le compte du MDN.

In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform contractors/consultants of upcoming contract opportunities at Canadian Forces Base (CFB) Gander, NL for Real Property Operations Group (RP OPS) and Canadian Forces Housing Agency (CFHA) base program.

The purpose of this APN is to allow contractors and consultants to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for potential solicitation processes, notably by initiating any necessary steps.

This is a preliminary notice regarding potential contracts, which may or may not include security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested contractors and consultants to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable).

Please note that certain projects may be reserved for Indigenous businesses in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB).

Please note that there is no guarantee that these solicitations will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process.

DESCRIPTION OF CFB Gander, NEWFOUNDLAND AND LABRADOR

CFB Gander is a key Canadian Armed Forces installation in central Newfoundland and Labrador, near the town of Gander. It serves as an air mobility and operational support hub, enabling domestic and international operations through airlift staging, logistics coordination, and support to regional and joint activities. The base hosts a range of lodger units, including air reserve, logistics, engineering, and support organizations.

Its operational footprint extends across the province through satellite sites, including armouries supporting the 2nd Battalion, Royal Newfoundland Regiment in Corner Brook and Grand Falls-Windsor, as well as CFS St. John&#39;s. These sites support distributed operations and regional presence. CFS St. John&rsquo;s, managed by 5th Canadian Division Support Base Gagetown, functions as a regional support station providing training, operational, and personnel support to Canadian Armed Forces units, including reserve units and cadet programs.

Together, the base and its satellite sites employ several hundred military and civilian personnel and maintain infrastructure including a large airfield capable of supporting heavy aircraft, hangars, logistics and warehousing facilities, training spaces, and administrative and support buildings. The Canadian Forces Housing Agency portfolio in Gander includes 72 Residential Housing Units supporting military families. CFB Gander continues to play a strategic role in regional operations and transatlantic aviation support.

CFB Gander continues to play a strategic role in regional operations and transatlantic aviation support.

Future contracts will be subject to separate tendering or request for proposals processes and awarded through various procurement mechanisms and tools made available to DCC.

	Open competitive tenders or requests for proposals advertised on MERX, and CanadaBuys if they are subject to one of Canada&rsquo;s trade agreements and their estimated value is equal to or above the agreement&rsquo;s dollar thresholds.
	Open Construction Source List (OCSL) &ndash; By invitation only to the members of the OCSL. The OCSL for CFB Gander is currently open on MERX and interested contractors are welcomed to apply. Search for AR26SLGR_86029 Open Construction Source List for 9 Wing Gander on MERX and follow the instructions to apply. IMPORTANT: A MERX account is required to apply.
	Source lists (SL) &ndash; Typically used for professional services such as A&amp;E or environmental. A source list may be local, regional, or national. Each SL is put in place via an open competitive process, advertised on MERX, and CanadaBuys where applicable. Members of the SL are then approached based on the criteria provided in the RFP to submit a proposal based on a provided Statement of Work (SOW). For most SL, the contracts are negotiated one-on-one.
	Standing Offer Agreement (SOA) and Standing Offer (SO) &ndash; Used for any type of services or construction and generally put in place with one of two suppliers. These tools may be local, regional, or national. Each tool is put in place via an open competitive process, advertised on MERX, and CanadaBuys where applicable or by invitation from an OCSL.

Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements

To be eligible for contract award, a proponent or bidder will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents.
Where applicable, the anticipated security clearance level for each contract is listed in the attached list of projects.

Industrial Security Program Sponsorship

Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing consultants or contractors early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, consultants or contractors that intend to submit a proposal or a bid on one or more of these projects and that do not actively hold the identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC&rsquo;s ISP.

Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential bidders or proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process.
To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC&rsquo;s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements.

In their sponsorship request application to DCC, consultants or contractors are asked to quote the following information, among other things:

	Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number (Project number on the MERX notice);
	Contract number or numbers as referenced in the attached table; and
	Level of clearance requested to be sponsored for.


Sponsorship Process

Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the consultants or contractors to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages.
Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a consultant or contractor:

	has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation(s) (Contract number(s) listed on their request for sponsorship) being advertised on MERX,
	has met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package, and
	has submitted a proposal or a bid

DCC will send the sponsorship request package to the Public Services and Procurement Canada&rsquo;s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP).
Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent or bidder regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent or bidder will need to promptly cooperate with CSP to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible.

Objectif du pr&eacute;sent pr&eacute;avis d&rsquo;approvisionnement (PA)

Dans le contexte des investissements majeurs annonc&eacute;s par le gouvernement et afin de favoriser un partenariat proactif avec l&rsquo;industrie, CDC diffuse le pr&eacute;sent pr&eacute;avis d&rsquo;approvisionnement (PA) afin d&rsquo;informer les entrepreneurs/experts-conseils des occasions de contrats &agrave; venir dans le cadre du programme de base du site de la BFC Gander, T.-N.-L, du Groupe des op&eacute;rations immobili&egrave;res (Gp Ops Imm)&nbsp;ainsi que du programme de base de l&rsquo;Agence de logement des Forces canadiennes (ALFC).
Le pr&eacute;sent PA vise &agrave; permettre aux entrepreneurs et aux experts-conseils d&rsquo;&eacute;valuer leur capacit&eacute; et leur int&eacute;r&ecirc;t &agrave; participer, ainsi que de se pr&eacute;parer ad&eacute;quatement en vue d&rsquo;&eacute;ventuels processus de sollicitation, notamment en amor&ccedil;ant les d&eacute;marches n&eacute;cessaires.

Il s&rsquo;agit d&rsquo;un avis pr&eacute;liminaire concernant des contrats potentiels, avec ou sans exigences en mati&egrave;re de s&eacute;curit&eacute;. Ce pr&eacute;avis vise &agrave; permettre aux entrepreneurs et aux experts-conseils int&eacute;ress&eacute;s la possibilit&eacute; d&rsquo;entamer, au besoin, le processus de parrainage afin d&rsquo;obtenir (si n&eacute;cessaires) les habilitations ou les habilitations de s&eacute;curit&eacute; requises.
&Agrave; noter que certains projets pourraient &ecirc;tre r&eacute;serv&eacute;s aux entreprises autochtones conform&eacute;ment &agrave; la Strat&eacute;gie d&rsquo;approvisionnement aupr&egrave;s des entreprises autochtones (SAEA).
Veuillez noter qu&rsquo;il n&rsquo;y a aucune garantie que ces sollicitations aboutiront ou que les habilitations de s&eacute;curit&eacute; seront accord&eacute;es dans les d&eacute;lais pr&eacute;vus ou autrement dans le cadre du processus de parrainage.

Il ne s&rsquo;agit pas d&rsquo;une demande de soumissions ni d&rsquo;une demande de propositions.

DESCRIPTION DE LA BFC GANDER

La Base des Forces canadiennes (BFC)&nbsp;Gander est une installation cl&eacute; des Forces arm&eacute;es canadiennes (FAC) situ&eacute;e au centre de Terre-Neuve-et-Labrador, pr&egrave;s de la ville de Gander. Elle sert de plaque tournante de la mobilit&eacute; a&eacute;rienne et de carrefour de soutien op&eacute;rationnel, facilitant les op&eacute;rations nationales et internationales gr&acirc;ce au rassemblement pour le transport a&eacute;rien, &agrave; la coordination de la logistique et au soutien aux activit&eacute;s r&eacute;gionales et conjointes. La base abrite bon nombre d&rsquo;unit&eacute;s h&eacute;berg&eacute;es, dont des organisations de la R&eacute;serve a&eacute;rienne, de logistique, de g&eacute;nie et de soutien.

Son empreinte op&eacute;rationnelle s&rsquo;&eacute;tend &agrave; l&rsquo;&eacute;chelle de la province gr&acirc;ce &agrave; des sites satellites, notamment les man&egrave;ges militaires soutenant le 2e&nbsp;Bataillon, The Royal Newfoundland Regiment &agrave; Corner Brook et Grand&nbsp;Falls-Windsor ainsi que la Station des Forces canadiennes (SFC) St.&nbsp;John&rsquo;s. Ces sites appuient la r&eacute;partition des op&eacute;rations ainsi que la pr&eacute;sence r&eacute;gionale. La SFC St.&nbsp;Johns, g&eacute;r&eacute;e par la Base de soutien de la 5e&nbsp;Division du Canada Gagetown, est une station de soutien r&eacute;gionale qui fournit du soutien en mati&egrave;re d&rsquo;entra&icirc;nement, d&rsquo;op&eacute;rations et de personnel aux unit&eacute;s des FAC, dont les unit&eacute;s de r&eacute;serve et les programmes des cadets.

La base et ses sites satellites emploient plusieurs centaines de militaires et de civils et maintiennent des infrastructures, notamment un vaste a&eacute;rodrome qui abrite des a&eacute;ronefs lourds, des hangars, des installations de logistique et d&rsquo;entreposage, des aires d&rsquo;entra&icirc;nement ainsi que des b&acirc;timents administratifs et de soutien. Le portefeuille de l&rsquo;Agence de logement des Forces canadiennes de Gander comprend 72&nbsp;unit&eacute;s de logement r&eacute;sidentiel qui permettent de loger les familles militaires. La BFC&nbsp;Gander continue de jouer un r&ocirc;le strat&eacute;gique dans les op&eacute;rations r&eacute;gionales et le soutien a&eacute;ronautique transatlantique.
CFB Gander continues to play a strategic role in regional operations and transatlantic aviation support.

le programme de parrainage de s&eacute;curit&eacute; industrielle (PSI)

Construction de D&eacute;fense Canada (CDC) offre aux firmes d&rsquo;experts-conseils ou aux entrepreneurs l&rsquo;opportunit&eacute; de se faire parrainer en vue d&rsquo;obtenir une attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute; par l&rsquo;entremise du Programme de s&eacute;curit&eacute; industrielle (PSI). Par cons&eacute;quent, les firmes d&rsquo;experts-conseils ou les entrepreneurs qui pr&eacute;voient pr&eacute;senter une proposition ou une soumission pour un ou plusieurs de ces projets et qui ne d&eacute;tiennent pas activement les attestations de s&eacute;curit&eacute; identifi&eacute;es doivent commencer imm&eacute;diatement le processus de demande d&rsquo;attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute; en faisant la demande par l&rsquo;interm&eacute;diaire du PSI de CDC.

Dans le cadre de ce programme, CDC peut, &agrave; son enti&egrave;re discr&eacute;tion, fournir une aide pr&eacute;liminaire pour le processus de parrainage visant l&rsquo;obtention d&rsquo;une attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute;.
Pour commencer ce processus, veuillez pr&eacute;senter une demande de parrainage &agrave; CDC en suivant les &eacute;tapes suivantes qui se trouvent sur son site Web &agrave;&nbsp;: https://www.cdc-dcc.gc.ca/industrie/exigences-de-s&eacute;curit&eacute;.

Dans la demande de parrainage qu&rsquo;ils pr&eacute;sentent &agrave; CDC, les firmes d&rsquo;experts-conseils ou entrepreneurs sont pri&eacute;s de notamment indiquer les renseignements suivants&nbsp;:

	Le num&eacute;ro du Pr&eacute;avis d&rsquo;approvisionnement; (Num&eacute;ro de projet dans l&rsquo;avis de MERX)
	Le ou les num&eacute;ro(s) du ou des contrat(s) comme indiqu&eacute; dans le tableau ci-joint; et,
	Le niveau de cote de s&eacute;curit&eacute; demand&eacute; dans le cadre du parrainage.

Processus de parrainage

&Agrave; la r&eacute;ception d&rsquo;une demande de parrainage, CDC l&rsquo;examine et communique directement avec la firme d&rsquo;experts-conseils ou entrepreneur pour compl&eacute;ter le dossier.
Une fois que CDC a d&eacute;termin&eacute;, &agrave; son enti&egrave;re discr&eacute;tion, qu&rsquo;une firme d&rsquo;experts-conseils ou un entrepreneur&nbsp;:

	a d&eacute;but&eacute; le processus de parrainage avant que la ou les sollicitations (num&eacute;ro(s) de contrat indiqu&eacute; sur leur demande de parrainage) ne soient annonc&eacute;es sur MERX,
	a satisfait &agrave; toutes les exigences mat&eacute;rielles de la trousse de demande de parrainage, et
	a d&eacute;pos&eacute; une proposition ou une soumission

CDC enverra la trousse de demande de parrainage au Programme de s&eacute;curit&eacute; des contrats (PSC) de Services publics et Approvisionnement Canada (SPAC).
Apr&egrave;s la r&eacute;ception du dossier de demande de parrainage, le PSC communique directement avec le proposant ou le soumissionnaire pour lui indiquer les prochaines &eacute;tapes, les mesures &agrave; prendre ou l&rsquo;&eacute;tat du traitement du dossier. Le proposant ou le soumissionnaire devra alors coop&eacute;rer avec le PSC en temps opportun pour faire avancer le processus.

Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice
This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals.

In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform contractors of an upcoming contract opportunity.

The purpose of this APN is to allow contractors to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps.

This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested contractors to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable).

Please note that this project may include Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB).

Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process.

Description of the Project and Services
It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed from DND.

APN Number: 86114
Approximate Estimate: $22M
Anticipated Posting: November 2026

Description:
Work of this contract comprises of the renovation of both building A-147 and A-149 at CFB Borden. Both existing accommodations are sites of extensive building upgrades that are primarily focused on addressing life-safety, building envelope upgrades, electrical, mechanical upgrades and roofing replacements.

Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements
To be eligible for contract award, a bidder will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents.

The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is Designated Organization Screening (DOS).

Industrial Security Program Sponsorship 
Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing contractors early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, contractors that intend to submit a bid for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC&rsquo;s ISP.

Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential bidders with their respective security clearance sponsorship process.

To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC&rsquo;s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements.
In their sponsorship request application to DCC, consultants or contractors are asked to quote the following information, among other things:

	Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number: 86114
	Level of clearance requested to be sponsored for.

Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the consultants or contractors to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages.

Objectif du pr&eacute;sent pr&eacute;avis d&rsquo;approvisionnement
Il ne s&rsquo;agit pas d&rsquo;une demande de soumissions ni d&rsquo;une demande de propositions.

Dans le contexte des investissements majeurs annonc&eacute;s par le gouvernement et afin de favoriser un partenariat proactif avec l&rsquo;industrie, CDC diffuse le pr&eacute;sent pr&eacute;avis d&rsquo;approvisionnement (PA) afin d&rsquo;informer les entrepreneurs d&rsquo;un contrat &agrave; venir.

Le pr&eacute;sent PA vise &agrave; permettre aux entrepreneurs d&rsquo;&eacute;valuer leur capacit&eacute; et leur int&eacute;r&ecirc;t &agrave; participer, ainsi que de se pr&eacute;parer ad&eacute;quatement en vue du processus de sollicitation, notamment en amor&ccedil;ant les d&eacute;marches n&eacute;cessaires.

Il s&rsquo;agit d&rsquo;un avis pr&eacute;liminaire concernant un contrat potentiel, avec des exigences en mati&egrave;re de s&eacute;curit&eacute;. Ce pr&eacute;avis vise &agrave; permettre aux entrepreneurs int&eacute;ress&eacute;s la possibilit&eacute; d&rsquo;entamer, au besoin, le processus de parrainage afin d&rsquo;obtenir (si n&eacute;cessaires) les habilitations ou les habilitations de s&eacute;curit&eacute; requises.

&Agrave; noter que le projet pourrait contenir un volet de participation pour entreprises autochtones conform&eacute;ment &agrave; la Strat&eacute;gie d&rsquo;approvisionnement aupr&egrave;s des entreprises autochtones (SAEA).

Veuillez noter qu&#39;il n&#39;y a aucune garantie que ce contrat aboutira ou que les habilitations de s&eacute;curit&eacute; seront accord&eacute;es dans les d&eacute;lais pr&eacute;vus ou autrement dans le cadre du processus de parrainage.

Description&nbsp;:

Parrainage du programme de s&eacute;curit&eacute; industrielle (PSI) 
Construction de D&eacute;fense Canada (CDC) offre aux entrepreneurs l&rsquo;opportunit&eacute; de se faire parrainer en vue d&rsquo;obtenir une attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute; par l&rsquo;entremise du Programme de s&eacute;curit&eacute; industrielle (PSI). Par cons&eacute;quent, les entrepreneurs qui pr&eacute;voient pr&eacute;senter une soumission pour ce projet et qui ne d&eacute;tiennent pas activement l&rsquo;attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute; identifi&eacute;e ci-dessus doivent commencer imm&eacute;diatement le processus de demande d&rsquo;attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute; en faisant la demande par l&rsquo;interm&eacute;diaire du PSI de CDC.

Dans le cadre de ce programme, CDC peut, &agrave; son enti&egrave;re discr&eacute;tion, fournir une aide pr&eacute;liminaire pour le processus de parrainage visant l&rsquo;obtention d&rsquo;une attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute;.

	Le niveau de cote de s&eacute;curit&eacute; demand&eacute; dans le cadre du parrainage.

Processus de parrainage
&Agrave; la r&eacute;ception d&rsquo;une demande de parrainage, CDC l&rsquo;examine et communique directement avec l&rsquo;entrepreneur pour compl&eacute;ter le dossier.

	a d&eacute;but&eacute; le processus de parrainage avant que la ou les sollicitations (num&eacute;ro(s) de contrat indiqu&eacute; sur leur demande de parrainage) ne soient annonc&eacute;es sur MERX,
	a satisfait &agrave; toutes les exigences mat&eacute;rielles de la trousse de demande de parrainage, et
	a d&eacute;pos&eacute; une proposition ou une soumission

CDC enverra la trousse de demande de parrainage au Programme de s&eacute;curit&eacute; des contrats (PSC) de Services publics et Approvisionnement Canada (SPAC).

Apr&egrave;s la r&eacute;ception du dossier de demande de parrainage, le PSC communique directement avec le proposant ou le soumissionnaire pour lui indiquer les prochaines &eacute;tapes, les mesures &agrave; prendre ou l&rsquo;&eacute;tat du traitement du dossier. Le proposant ou le soumissionnaire devra alors coop&eacute;rer avec le PSC en temps opportun pour faire avancer le processus.

Commissioning services in Support of National Defence Secure Campus, Ottawa, ON (with Security Requirements)
Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice
This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals.
In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform consultants of an upcoming contract opportunity in Ottawa, ON.
The purpose of this APN is to allow consultants to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps.
This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested consultants to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable).
Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process.

Description of the Project and Services
The consultant will provide commissioning oversight for building and specialty systems including but not limited to mechanical, electrical, building envelope, roofing, fire alarm, security, and telecommunications systems in support of the National Defence Secure Campus (NDSC) project at the National Defence Headquarters (NDHQ) Carling Campus in Ottawa, ON. The services will be procured through a Request for Abbreviated Proposal (RFAP), with the total potential opportunity estimated at $20,000,000.
The solicitation is expected to be issued in Winter 2027. This is conditional on receiving approval to proceed from DND.

Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements
To be eligible for contract award, a proponent will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents.
The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is FSC at Secret level.

Industrial Security Program Sponsorship 
Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing consultants early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, consultants that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC&rsquo;s ISP.
Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process.
To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC&rsquo;s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements.
In their sponsorship request application to DCC, consultants are asked to quote the following information, among other things:

	Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number (Project number on the MERX notice);
	Contract number 87740; and
	Level of clearance requested to be sponsored for.

Sponsorship Process
Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the consultants to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages.
Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a consultant:

	has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation (Contract number listed on their request for sponsorship) being advertised on MERX,
	has met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package, and
	has submitted a proposal

DCC will send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada&rsquo;s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP).
Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent will need to promptly cooperate with CSP to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible.
Questions
Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to:
Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or
Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca

1. PURPOSE OF THIS ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE

In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform contractors of an upcoming contract opportunity at 19 Wing, CFB Comox, Lazo, BC.
The purpose of this APN is to allow contractors to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process.
This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested contractors to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable).

2. DESCRIPTION OF THE PROJECT AND SERVICES

It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed from DND.

APN or Contract Number: 87758
Approximate Estimate: $9,300,000
Anticipated Posting: January 2027

Description: Remediation of PFAS-impacted soils at CFB Comox through in-situ soil mixing (chemical) and stabilization, selective excavation, off-site disposal, drainage improvements, and site restoration.

Construction will be completed in two distinct phases due to schedule constraints, UXO sequencing, and constructability considerations.

Description&nbsp;: Assainissement des sols contamin&eacute;s par des substances perfluoroalkyl&eacute;es et polyfluoroalkyl&eacute;es (PFAS) &agrave; la BFC&nbsp;Comox au moyen d&#39;un m&eacute;lange (chimique) et de la stabilisation des sols in&nbsp;situ, de travaux d&#39;excavation s&eacute;lective, de l&rsquo;&eacute;limination hors site, d&#39;am&eacute;liorations du drainage et de la remise en &eacute;tat du site.

Construction de D&eacute;fense Canada (CDC) offre aux entrepreneurs l&rsquo;opportunit&eacute; de se faire parrainer en vue d&rsquo;obtenir une attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute; par l&rsquo;entremise du Programme de s&eacute;curit&eacute; industrielle (PSI). Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice
This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals.

In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform contractors of an upcoming contract opportunity at Canadian Forces Base (CFB) Trenton, ON.

The purpose of this APN is to allow contractors to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps.

This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested contractors to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable).

Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process.

Please note that this project may include Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB).

Description of the Project and Services
It is anticipated that the following 2-Step (Step 1: Request for Expression of Interest, Step 2: Tender Phase) solicitation will proceed as noted below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed from DND.

APN Number: TRS18081_73944
Approximate Estimate: $11M - $13M
Anticipated Posting Step 1: Fall 2026
Anticipated Posting Step 2: Fall 2026

Description:
Work of this contract comprises general contracting services and the supply and installation of all materials and labour required to construct a warehouse facility. The proposed facility will provide warehouse space for the Combat Aerial Delivery Support Section/Major Air Disaster (CADSS/MAJAID) Unit. The facility will support unit operations, including parachute inspection, drying, preparation, and packing activities; a dedicated carpentry shop; storage of operational material and equipment; and administrative office space. The facility will also accommodate material handling and warehouse operations, including the use of forklifts and other machinery within the building. The total estimated gross area of the project 1,554 m2.

Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements
To be eligible for contract award, a bidder will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents.

The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is Designated Organization Screening (DOS).

Industrial Security Program Sponsorship 
Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing contractors early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, contractors that intend to submit a bid for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC&rsquo;s ISP.

Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential bidders with their respective security clearance sponsorship process.

To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC&rsquo;s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements.

In their sponsorship request application to DCC, consultants or contractors are asked to quote the following information, among other things:

	Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number (TRS18081_73944);
	Level of clearance requested to be sponsored for.

At such time, the proponent or bidder will need to promptly cooperate with CSP to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible.

Objectif du pr&eacute;sent pr&eacute;avis d&rsquo;approvisionnement
Il ne s&rsquo;agit pas d&rsquo;une demande de soumissions ni d&rsquo;une demande de propositions.

Dans le contexte des investissements majeurs annonc&eacute;s par le gouvernement et afin de favoriser un partenariat proactif avec l&rsquo;industrie, CDC diffuse le pr&eacute;sent pr&eacute;avis d&rsquo;approvisionnement (PA) afin d&rsquo;informer les entrepreneurs d&rsquo;un contrat &agrave; venir &agrave; la Base des Forces canadiennes (BFC) Trenton, ON.

Description du projet et des services

Data Center, (Modify design Built)
National Capital Region 
(with Security Requirements)


	Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice


This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals.
In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform design-builders of an upcoming contract opportunity located within the National Capital Region (Ontario).
The purpose of this APN is to allow design-builders to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps.
This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested design-builders to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable).
Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process.
Please note that this project may include Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB).


	Description of the Project and Services


It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed

Project Number: WA257004
Contract Number: 88262
Title: Data Center NCR
Approximate Estimate: 1.5B to 1.85B
Anticipated Posting: Winter 2027

Description:
To increase its capacity in supporting the mid to long-term objectives related to operations, security, and technology modernization, the Government of Canada is planning to design and construction a data center facility within the National Capital Region.
This Data center of 60 MW will enable the onboarding of next-generation capabilities with tailored mechanical and electrical configurations to meet distinct technology requirements throughout the facility. The proposed data centre facility will also include a small office space and a shipping and receiving area.

The estimated cost of the proposed Modified Design-Build (MDB) Contract exceeds $1.5 to 1.85B.

It is anticipated that this solicitation will be initiated in Winter 2027.&nbsp; This is conditional on receiving approval to proceed by the Government of Canada.


	Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements


To be eligible for contract award, a proponent will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents.
As of the date of posting of this Advance Procurement Notice, the required security clearance(s) are anticipated to be:


	for design-builders: a valid Facility Security Clearance (FSC).



	&nbsp;Industrial Security Program Sponsorship 


Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing design-builders early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, design-builders that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC&rsquo;s ISP.
Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process.
To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC&rsquo;s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements.
In their sponsorship request application to DCC, design-builders are asked to quote the following information, among other things:


	
	Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number, as identified in Section 2 of this APN; and
	
	
	Level of clearance requested to be sponsored, as identified in Section 3 of this APN.
	



	Sponsorship Process


Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the design-builders to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages.
Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a design-builders


	has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation being advertised on MERX,
	has met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package prior to the closing date indicated in the solicitation, and
	has submitted a proposal.


&nbsp;

DCC will send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada&rsquo;s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP).
Note &ndash; Design-Builder that do not submit a proposal will not be able to attain clearance through this sponsorship process.

Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent will need to promptly cooperate with CSP to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible.

	OBJECTIF DU PR&Eacute;SENT PR&Eacute;AVIS D&rsquo;APPROVISIONNEMENT


Il ne s&rsquo;agit pas d&rsquo;une demande de soumission ni d&rsquo;une demande de proposition.
Dans le contexte des investissements majeurs annonc&eacute;s par le gouvernement et afin de favoriser un partenariat proactif avec l&rsquo;industrie, CDC diffuse le pr&eacute;sent pr&eacute;avis d&rsquo;approvisionnement (PA) afin d&rsquo;informer les concepteurs-constructeurs d&rsquo;un contrat &agrave; venir dans la R&eacute;gion de la capitale nationale.
Le pr&eacute;sent PA vise &agrave; permettre aux concepteurs-constructeurs d&rsquo;&eacute;valuer leur capacit&eacute; et leur int&eacute;r&ecirc;t &agrave; y participer, ainsi que de se pr&eacute;parer ad&eacute;quatement en vue du processus de sollicitation.
Il s&rsquo;agit d&rsquo;un avis pr&eacute;liminaire concernant un contrat potentiel qui comporte des exigences en mati&egrave;re de s&eacute;curit&eacute;. Ce pr&eacute;avis vise &agrave; permettre aux concepteurs-constructeurs qui le souhaitent la possibilit&eacute; d&rsquo;entamer, au besoin, le processus de parrainage afin d&rsquo;obtenir (si n&eacute;cessaire) les habilitations ou les attestations de s&eacute;curit&eacute; requises.
Veuillez noter qu&rsquo;il n&rsquo;y a aucune garantie que ce contrat sera mis de l&rsquo;avant ni que les attestations de s&eacute;curit&eacute; seront accord&eacute;es dans les d&eacute;lais anticip&eacute;s ou seront m&ecirc;me accord&eacute;es dans le cadre du processus de parrainage.
&Agrave; noter que le projet pourrait comprendre un volet de participation pour entreprises autochtones conform&eacute;ment &agrave; la Strat&eacute;gie d&rsquo;approvisionnement aupr&egrave;s des entreprises autochtones (SAEA).

	DESCRIPTION DU PROJET ET DES SERVICES

Num&eacute;ro de projet&nbsp;: WA257004
Num&eacute;ro de contrat&nbsp;: 82262

Description&nbsp;:

	Exigences &eacute;ventuelles en mati&egrave;re de s&eacute;curit&eacute; et d&rsquo;attribution du contrat


Pour &ecirc;tre admissible &agrave; l&rsquo;attribution d&rsquo;un contrat, un soumissionnaire sera tenu, entre autres, d&eacute;tenir toute cote de s&eacute;curit&eacute; requise avant la date de l&rsquo;octroi du contrat, comme il sera indiqu&eacute; en d&eacute;tail dans les documents de la sollicitation.

	pour les concepteurs-constructeurs&nbsp;: une attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute; d&rsquo;installation (ASI) valide.



	Parrainage dans le cadre du Programme de s&eacute;curit&eacute; industrielle (PSI)


Construction de D&eacute;fense Canada (CDC) offre aux concepteurs-constructeurs l&rsquo;opportunit&eacute; de se faire parrainer en vue d&rsquo;obtenir une attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute; par l&rsquo;entremise du Programme de s&eacute;curit&eacute; industrielle (PSI). Par cons&eacute;quent, les concepteurs-constructeurs qui pr&eacute;voient pr&eacute;senter une proposition pour ce projet et qui ne d&eacute;tiennent pas activement l&rsquo;attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute; identifi&eacute;e ci-dessus devraient commencer imm&eacute;diatement le processus de demande d&rsquo;attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute; en faisant la demande par l&rsquo;interm&eacute;diaire du PSI de CDC.
Dans le cadre de ce programme, CDC peut, &agrave; son enti&egrave;re discr&eacute;tion, fournir une aide pr&eacute;liminaire aux soumissionnaires potentiels pour le processus de parrainage visant l&rsquo;obtention d&rsquo;une attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute;.
Pour commencer ce processus, veuillez pr&eacute;senter une demande de parrainage &agrave; CDC en suivant les &eacute;tapes suivantes qui se trouvent sur son site Web &agrave;&nbsp;: https://www.cdc-dcc.gc.ca/industrie/exigences-de-s&eacute;curit&eacute;.
Dans la demande de parrainage qu&rsquo;ils pr&eacute;sentent &agrave; CDC, les experts-conseils ou entrepreneurs ou sont pri&eacute;s de notamment indiquer les renseignements suivants&nbsp;:


	Le num&eacute;ro du pr&eacute;avis d&rsquo;approvisionnement, tel qu&rsquo;indiqu&eacute; &agrave; la section&nbsp;2 de ce PA;
	Le niveau de cote de s&eacute;curit&eacute; demand&eacute; dans le cadre du parrainage, tel qu&rsquo;indiqu&eacute; &agrave; la section&nbsp;3 de ce PA.



	Processus de parrainage


&Agrave; la r&eacute;ception d&rsquo;une demande de parrainage, CDC l&rsquo;examine et communique directement avec l&rsquo;expert-conseil ou l&rsquo;entrepreneur pour compl&eacute;ter le dossier.
Une fois que CDC a d&eacute;termin&eacute;, &agrave; son enti&egrave;re discr&eacute;tion, qu&rsquo;un expert-conseil ou entrepreneur&nbsp;:


	a d&eacute;but&eacute; le processus de parrainage avant que la sollicitation ne soit annonc&eacute;e sur MERX;
	a satisfait &agrave; toutes les exigences mat&eacute;rielles de la trousse de demande de parrainage avant la date de fermeture indiqu&eacute;e dans la sollicitation;
	a d&eacute;pos&eacute; une proposition.


CDC enverra la trousse de demande de parrainage au Programme de s&eacute;curit&eacute; des contrats (PSC) de Services publics et Approvisionnement Canada (SPAC).
Remarque&nbsp;: Les entrepreneurs ou experts-conseils qui ne transmettent pas de proposition ne pourront pas obtenir d&rsquo;attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute; dans le cadre de ce processus de parrainage.

Apr&egrave;s la r&eacute;ception du dossier de demande de parrainage, le PSC communique directement avec le soumissionnaire pour lui indiquer les prochaines &eacute;tapes, les mesures &agrave; prendre ou l&rsquo;&eacute;tat du traitement du dossier. Le soumissionnaire sera alors tenu de coop&eacute;rer avec le PSC en temps opportun pour faire avancer le processus.

Veuillez noter qu&rsquo;il n&rsquo;y a aucune garantie que ce contrat sera mis de l&rsquo;avant ni que les attestations de s&eacute;curit&eacute; seront accord&eacute;es dans les d&eacute;lais anticip&eacute;s ou seront m&ecirc;me accord&eacute;es dans le cadre du processus de parrainage.

&Agrave; noter que le projet pourrait comprendre un volet de participation pour entreprises autochtones conform&eacute;ment &agrave; la Strat&eacute;gie d&rsquo;approvisionnement aupr&egrave;s des entreprises autochtones (SAEA).

2. DESCRIPTION DU PROJET ET DES SERVICES

L&rsquo;aire de trafic B Est de la base a&eacute;rienne de la 15e&nbsp;Escadre Moose Jaw, Saskatchewan n&eacute;cessite d&rsquo;&ecirc;tre r&eacute;par&eacute; et remplac&eacute;. Le minist&egrave;re de la D&eacute;fense nationale (MDN) et Construction de D&eacute;fense Canada (CDC) ont l&rsquo;intention de mettre en place un contrat pour fournir l&rsquo;ensemble de la main-d&rsquo;&oelig;uvre, du mat&eacute;riel et de l&rsquo;&eacute;quipement n&eacute;cessaires pour&nbsp;:&nbsp;
&nbsp;

	Installation de cl&ocirc;tures de s&eacute;curit&eacute; temporaires et de barri&egrave;res construction&nbsp;
	D&eacute;molition et enl&egrave;vement de la chauss&eacute;e de b&eacute;ton existante&nbsp;
	Enl&egrave;vement partiel de la fondation granulaire existante&nbsp;
	D&eacute;capage et mise en d&eacute;p&ocirc;t de la terre v&eacute;g&eacute;tale&nbsp;
	Nivellement et compactage de la fondation granulaire existante et mise en place d&rsquo;une nouvelle fondation granulaire&nbsp;
	Construction de nouvelles chauss&eacute;es en b&eacute;ton au ciment Portland&nbsp;
	Pose d&rsquo;un nouveau scellement des joints et d&rsquo;un nouveau marquage au sol&nbsp;
	Am&eacute;nagement paysager, y compris la terre v&eacute;g&eacute;tale, l&rsquo;engrais et l&rsquo;ensemencement hydraulique&nbsp;
	&nbsp;

La sollicitation suivante devrait &ecirc;tre mise de l&rsquo;avant comme indiqu&eacute; dans le tableau ci-dessous. Ceci est conditionnel &agrave; l&rsquo;approbation du contrat par le MDN.

Num&eacute;ro de contrat&nbsp;: CN88327
Titre&nbsp;: Projet de remplacement de la rampe B &ndash; Est, 15e&nbsp;Escadre Moose Jaw, Saskatchewan
Estim&eacute; approximatif&nbsp;: 16&nbsp;000&nbsp;000&nbsp;$
Date de publication pr&eacute;vue&nbsp;: Janvier 2027

3. Exigences &eacute;ventuelles en mati&egrave;re de s&eacute;curit&eacute; et d&rsquo;attribution du contrat
Pour &ecirc;tre admissible &agrave; l&rsquo;attribution d&rsquo;un contrat, un soumissionnaire devra, entre autres, d&eacute;tenir toute cote de s&eacute;curit&eacute; requise avant la date de l&rsquo;octroi du contrat, comme il sera indiqu&eacute; en d&eacute;tail dans les documents de la sollicitation.

Selon les pr&eacute;visions, ce contrat n&eacute;cessitera une v&eacute;rification d&rsquo;organisation d&eacute;sign&eacute;e (VOD).

4. Parrainage dans le cadre du Programme de s&eacute;curit&eacute; industrielle (PSI)
Construction de D&eacute;fense Canada (CDC) offre aux entrepreneurs l&rsquo;opportunit&eacute; de se faire parrainer en vue d&rsquo;obtenir une attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute; par l&rsquo;entremise du Programme de s&eacute;curit&eacute; industrielle (PSI). Par cons&eacute;quent, les entrepreneurs qui pr&eacute;voient pr&eacute;senter une soumission pour ce projet et qui ne d&eacute;tiennent pas activement l&rsquo;attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute; identifi&eacute;e ci-dessus devraient commencer imm&eacute;diatement le processus de demande d&rsquo;attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute; en faisant la demande par l&rsquo;interm&eacute;diaire du PSI de CDC.

Dans le cadre de ce programme, CDC peut, &agrave; son enti&egrave;re discr&eacute;tion, fournir une aide pr&eacute;liminaire aux soumissionnaires pour le processus de parrainage visant l&rsquo;obtention d&rsquo;une attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute;.

Pour commencer ce processus, veuillez pr&eacute;senter une demande de parrainage &agrave; CDC en suivant les &eacute;tapes suivantes qui se trouvent sur son site Web &agrave;&nbsp;: https://www.cdc-dcc.gc.ca/industrie/exigences-de-s&eacute;curit&eacute;.

Dans la demande de parrainage qu&rsquo;ils pr&eacute;sentent &agrave; CDC, les entrepreneurs sont pri&eacute;s de notamment indiquer les renseignements suivants&nbsp;:

	Le num&eacute;ro du pr&eacute;avis d&rsquo;approvisionnement (PA), tel qu&rsquo;indiqu&eacute; &agrave; la section&nbsp;2 de ce PA;
	Le niveau de cote de s&eacute;curit&eacute; demand&eacute; dans le cadre du parrainage, tel qu&rsquo;indiqu&eacute; &agrave; la section&nbsp;3 de ce PA.


5. Processus de parrainage
&Agrave; la r&eacute;ception d&rsquo;une demande de parrainage, CDC l&rsquo;examine et communique directement avec l&rsquo;entrepreneur pour compl&eacute;ter le dossier.

Une fois que CDC a d&eacute;termin&eacute;, &agrave; son enti&egrave;re discr&eacute;tion, qu&rsquo;un entrepreneur&nbsp;:

	a d&eacute;but&eacute; le processus de parrainage avant que la sollicitation ne soit annonc&eacute;e sur MERX;
	a satisfait &agrave; toutes les exigences mat&eacute;rielles de la trousse de demande de parrainage avant la date de fermeture indiqu&eacute;e dans la sollicitation;
	a d&eacute;pos&eacute; une soumission.

CDC enverra la trousse de demande de parrainage au Programme de s&eacute;curit&eacute; des contrats (PSC) de Services publics et Approvisionnement Canada (SPAC).

Remarque&nbsp;: Les entrepreneurs qui ne transmettent pas de soumission ne pourront pas obtenir d&rsquo;attestation de s&eacute;curit&eacute; dans le cadre de ce processus de parrainage.

Apr&egrave;s la r&eacute;ception du dossier de demande de parrainage, le PSC communique directement avec le soumissionnaire pour lui indiquer les prochaines &eacute;tapes, les mesures &agrave; prendre ou l&rsquo;&eacute;tat du traitement du dossier. Le soumissionnaire devra alors coop&eacute;rer avec le PSC en temps opportun pour faire avancer le processus.

6. Des questions?
Vous pouvez transmettre toute question concernant le processus de parrainage par l&rsquo;interm&eacute;diaire du PSI &agrave;&nbsp;:

Num&eacute;ro de t&eacute;l&eacute;phone&nbsp;: 613-998-8974

Shared Services Canada (SSC) has a requirement for the provision and operation of Lightspeed Low Earth Orbiting satellite services (called Lightspeed Services) as provided by Telesat LEO ULC on an as-and-when required basis for use by SSC and its partner organizations/clients.

Lightspeed provides Canada’s only sovereign enterprise-grade low earth orbit satellite constellation. Lightspeed has inter-satellite link capabilities, enabling any traffic originating outside of Canada to land in Canada (within applicable regulatory policies) directly through Canadian gateways.&nbsp; 

Lightspeed Services are categorized by its low latency, high throughput, dedicated bandwidth capacity (committed information rate), public networking along with terrestrial landing station infrastructure and Points of Presence (PoP) globally, private networking with Private Access Stations (PAS) at their facilities, dedicated backhaul capability, enterprise level and fully managed services capability and coverage of Canada; and&nbsp; globally.&nbsp; Enterprise level and fully managed services include, but are not limited to: site survey, installation, commissioning, helpdesk, billing, ongoing maintenance, engineering and customer support.

Recapitalize Anti Armour Range
(MODIFIED DESIGN-BUILD)
5 CDSB Gagetown, Oromocto, NB.
(with Security Requirements)

Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice

This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals.


In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform design-builders of an upcoming contract opportunity at 5 CDSB Gagetown, Oromocto, NB.


The purpose of this APN is to allow design-builders to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps.


This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested design-builders to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable).


Please note that this project may include Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB).
Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process.


Description of the Project and Services


It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed from DND.


Contract Number: HQ04022_86689
Title: Recapitalize Anti Armour Range
Approximate Estimate: $109M
Anticipated Posting: November 2026


Description:


The proposed recapitalization work includes:

	Upgrade Firing Point 6 (FP6) to serve as a replacement for Firing Point 4 (FP4), ensuring continued Level 5/6 training capability during construction.
	The FP6 recapitalization includes four new 2 km long firing lanes, crossing lanes for target access, protective berms, fire base pads, unexploded ordnance (UXO) clearance, vegetation management, arc markers, buried electrical conduits for target systems, a multi-storey control tower, and a climate-controlled sentry shack.
	Once FP6 is operational, FP4 will be upgraded with four recapitalized firing lanes, crossing lanes, protective berms, tank table positions, UXO clearance, vegetation management, arc markers, buried electrical conduits
	New approximately 455 m&sup2; climate-controlled administrative building, and refurbishment of the existing control tower.


Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements


To be eligible for contract award, a proponent will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents.


The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is Designated Organization Screening (DOS).

Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing design-builders early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, design-builders that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC&rsquo;s ISP.


Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process.

Description du projet et des services


La sollicitation suivante devrait &ecirc;tre mise de l&rsquo;avant comme indiqu&eacute; dans le tableau ci-dessous. Ceci est conditionnel &agrave; l&rsquo;approbation du contrat par le MDN.


Num&eacute;ro de contrat&nbsp;: HQ04022_86689
Titre&nbsp;: R&eacute;fection du champ de tir antiblind&eacute;
Estim&eacute; approximatif&nbsp;: 109&nbsp;M$
Date d&rsquo;affichage pr&eacute;vue&nbsp;: Novembre&nbsp;2026


Description&nbsp;:


Les travaux de r&eacute;fection propos&eacute;s comprennent&nbsp;:

	La modernisation du pas de tir&nbsp;6 (PT6), qui remplacera le pas de tir&nbsp;4 (PT4), afin d&rsquo;assurer le maintien de la capacit&eacute; de formation de niveau 5/6 pendant les travaux de construction.
	La r&eacute;fection du PT6 comprend quatre nouveaux couloirs de tir de 2&nbsp;km de long, des couloirs de passage pour acc&eacute;der aux cibles, des bermes de protection, des plateformes de tir, l&rsquo;&eacute;limination des munitions explosives non explos&eacute;es (UXO), la gestion de la v&eacute;g&eacute;tation, des marqueurs d&rsquo;arc de tir, des conduits &eacute;lectriques enfouis pour les syst&egrave;mes de cible, une tour de contr&ocirc;le de plusieurs &eacute;tages et un poste de garde climatis&eacute;.
	Une fois que le PT6 sera fonctionnel, on proc&eacute;dera &agrave; la modernisation du PT4 qui comprendra quatre couloirs de tir r&eacute;nov&eacute;s, des couloirs de passage, des bermes de protection, des plateformes de tir pour chars, l&rsquo;&eacute;limination des munitions explosives non explos&eacute;es (UXO), la gestion de la v&eacute;g&eacute;tation, des marqueurs d&rsquo;arc de tir et des conduits &eacute;lectriques enfouis.

	a satisfait &agrave; toutes les exigences mat&eacute;rielles de la trousse de demande de parrainage, et
	a d&eacute;pos&eacute; une proposition ou une soumission

DEFENCE CONSTRUCTION CANADA (DCC) &ndash; Project No. HQ04022_88127 &ndash; Request for Expression of Interest (RFEOI) for Enniskillen Road Upgrade, Gagetown, NB
Defence Construction Canada (DCC) invites general contractors to express their interest in providing all labour, materials, and equipment necessary for the Enniskillen Road Upgrade at Gagetown, NB

This Request for Expression of Interest (RFEOI) is the first step of a two-step solicitation process, the second step being the Tender Phase.&nbsp; Only general contractors that have expressed their interest through the Electronic Bidding System prior to the closing date and time of this RFEOI will be invited to submit a proposal at the second stage. Only submissions received in accordance with the requirements of the Electronic Bidding System will be considered.

Only the general contractors who will have responded to this RFEOI will be invited to submit a bid during the Tender Phase.

DCC reserves the right to terminate this solicitation at the end of the RFEOI.

As part of Canada&rsquo;s commitment to maximize the participation of Indigenous Businesses, bidders are advised that this solicitation includes an Indigenous Benefits Plan (IBP). The Contractor will have to include Indigenous businesses (or eligible joint ventures) as subcontractors or suppliers to this project. Further details will be provided in the Tender phase.

This solicitation is being conducted in accordance with the requirements set out in the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA), the Canada-European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) and the World Trade Organization Agreement on Government Procurement (WTO-GPA).


Project background

A detailed project background can be reviewed in the Building Summary

Documents

Technical plans and specifications are not available during this RFEOI and will be provided during the Tender Phase; however, the Standard Construction Contract Documents for Electronic Bidding, DCL 250E, are available on DCC&#39;s website: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/forms.


Tenderers are advised that this contract is subject to DCC&#39;s Procurement Code of Conduct, which can be downloaded at https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/forms. A contractor or supplier who has been declared ineligible or suspended by Public Services and Procurement Canada under its Ineligibility and Suspension Policy and whose period of ineligibility or suspension may not have expired will not be able to proceed to the second stage.


Bid security will be required during the Tender Phase in accordance with DCL193E- Instructions for Bidders for Electronic Bidding item 5.


Estimate


The Rough Order Magnitude estimate / Construction Cost Limit for this Contract is $ 25,642,471.00.


This amount includes all construction costs, on-site work (including all required services, parking, and landscaping), site utilities, necessary redundant mechanical systems, communication conduits and wiring, backup power equipment, built-in equipment, built-in furniture, and inflation to achieve substantial completion.
This amount excludes HST, design costs, travel and disbursements, consultant fees and expenses, movable equipment and furniture, IT equipment and contingencies.

	Schedule

DCC will proceed with the Tender Phase around November - December 2026.
The works shall reach substantial completion no later than October 15, 2027 and shall be completed no later than November 15, 2027.\
